subject.title: Legacy google provider block fails current model-catalog schema (missing api, input audio/video, cost.cacheWrite) → provider silently unavailable + 120s idle timeout on fallback

question: Which open Google legacy-provider migration PR should be the canonical landing path, and should fallback idle-timeout behavior remain tracked separately before this issue closes?
rationale: The issue has multiple unmerged candidate PRs with overlapping scope, while the report contains both a migration gap and a runtime fallback failure mode.

options.title: Pick one migration PR and split fallback tracking
options.body: Use the best proof-backed migration branch as canonical, then keep or create a narrow follow-up for unavailable-model fail-fast or fallback continuation.

options.title: Broaden the canonical PR
options.body: Ask the chosen PR to cover both the Google config migration and fallback idle-timeout behavior before it closes this issue.

options.title: Close on migration only
options.body: Treat the migration as sufficient to resolve the user blocker and accept that fallback behavior is not separately tracked.

recommendation.title: Pick one migration PR and split fallback tracking
recommendation.body: Use the best proof-backed migration branch as canonical, then keep or create a narrow follow-up for unavailable-model fail-fast or fallback continuation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has adjacent Google provider history and merged the prior Google default-api repair, making him the best routing candidate for the provider-boundary and closure-scope choice.
